About

A grounds company. No invented origin story.

Texas Landscape Services does not publish a founding year, owner biography, or list of licenses. This page does not fill those gaps in.

What they do publish is the work: commercial landscape management for property companies, healthcare facilities, owners, developers, and HOAs, plus estate and residential grounds.

Their own wording puts the difference in responsiveness and in a program written for the property — plant choices that fit the site, and maintenance that keeps the picture from falling apart.

They describe a team that expects quality. No individual names are listed on the public site, so none are listed here.
